Description: Students face daily stress from academic workload, screen time, and lifestyle habits, but rarely have a simple, objective way to measure or track it.
A Python program takes 5 daily lifestyle inputs (sleep hours, study hours, screen time, social activity, exercise) and calculates a stress score using a weighted formula.
A stress score from 0-100, classified as Low, Medium, or High
Give students early, data-driven awareness of their stress levels so they can make lifestyle adjustments before stress becomes overwhelming
